data.name: Dinakar
data.long_meaning: The name Dinakar is derived from two Sanskrit words: ‘Dina’ meaning ‘day’ and ‘Kara’ meaning ‘to do’. Thus, Dinakar translates to ‘God of the day’ or ‘Ruler of the day’. It is believed that this name brings the blessings of the sun god Surya, who is responsible for the cycle of days and the passing of time.
